text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. There's something I'd like
to consult you about, if that's alright?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Trainer-chan. There's something I'd like to consult you about, if you don't mind?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Um, some of the younger girls invited me, so we're going on an outing together soon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Shopping in a trendy part of town, huh?
It really feels like being on the cutting edge of fashion, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still, there's just oooone tiny little thing I'm worried about...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I mean, trends change super fast these days, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've been studying hard too, but whenever I talk with everyone—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes wonder, "Wait, am I not getting through?"
You get that too sometimes, don't you, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes wonder, "Wait, am I not getting through?"
You get that too sometimes, don't you, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And when you've gone out of your way to take a trip, wouldn't it be awful if the mood got awkward?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Give me some good ideas
so we don't disappoint everyone!
choice_data_list: Let's do some special training to hone our sense of style!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see. You mean checking out the latest trends together with Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see. You mean checking out the latest trends together with Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll be counting on you.
I came to town together with Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-kun,
let's check out the trends in this town right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-chan,
let's check out the trends in this town right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a CD shop over there.
I wonder if they have the latest hit songs?
Following Maruzensky's point, there was an old record shop.
choice_data_list: Chasing trends is a bit much for me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? Ah, so they don't carry
the latest tracks, huh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that boutique over there!
I can sense such a stylish vibe from it!
Following Maruzensky's point, there was a vintage clothing store with a distinct sense of nostalgia.
choice_data_list: It might not be in trend right now...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?
In that case, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Latest trends are tough to grasp.
None of it really clicks with me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mom said that as long as I nailed down things like this, everything would be peachy, but still...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my mother. Energetic, cheerful,
and a wonderful person who's so much fun to be around!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's super stylish, and it's something I've admired ever since I was a kid~.
Maruzensky looked so happy whenever she talked about her mother.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try telling them what your mother taught you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For the younger students?
I see... That's actually a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, basically, I just have to teach everyone
the latest trends I've learned, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Setting trends is way more fun than just following them anyway.
Alright, I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, listen to this~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, listen to this~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I went out with the younger girls,
and we had such a blast!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I got to recommend my favorite spots and everything,
and it seemed like a totally fresh experience for them♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We made a promise to go out again sometime, too.
Fufu, I wonder where we should go next~♪

"Maruzensky's bright smile spoke volumes
about the wonderful memories made that day..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Does that mean having confidence in my own taste...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right, maybe I really was
getting a little faint-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hesitating out of anxiety
just doesn't feel like me, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta believe in yourself!
Believe that you're always running at the front of the trend!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right. Everyone should already know about my good taste...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm the trendiest Umamusume around,
and my buzzwords are totes purr-fect!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, big sis is gonna give it her all!
I'm gonna enjoy every bit of this outing with my cute underclassman♪
Later on, I asked Maruzensky about how the outing went.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, listening to your advice was the right call.
I was able to get much closer with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"We went shopping together, had a meal,
and then even went to karaoke!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I sang lots of hit songs that my mom taught me♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She said it was fun getting to hear
a lot of songs she didn't really know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've learned all kinds of trends from everyone, too.
It's been such a great experience~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's show everyone just how
even more trendy I've become♪

A charming older sister, unique sense of style and all—
that was Maruzensky...
